dedupe_keys.name: replication data for bed morphodynamics at the intake of a side channel controlled by sill geometry

description: Wageningen provides replication data for a mobile-bed physical scale model of a Waal River side-channel entrance controlled by sill geometry. The source tests alternative sill designs, discharge division and morphodynamic equilibrium. It describes depositional and divergence bars under low flow and erosion during high flow. Laboratory experiments mimic field conditions associated with longitudinal training dams replacing groynes. Coverage: A complete source observation interval is unstated. Access: public native metadata identifies this release and its stated formats. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Current distribution access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: The named Waal site is the represented river context, not an asserted laboratory location. Measurement periods, scale ratio and numerical sampling remain unstated. Related field-monitoring data have a separate native identity. The data and claims about maintenance reduction were not independently examined. Its simulation use concerns the source-described physical modelling of alternative river-infrastructure sill designs.
